Aclaris Therapeutics to Participate in the 2026 Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference


May 28, 2026


WAYNE, Pa., May 28, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Aclaris Therapeutics, Inc. (NASDAQ: ACRS), a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company focused on developing novel product candidates for immuno-inflammatory diseases, today announced that on Thursday June 4, 2026, at 2:00 PM ET, Aclaris’ Chief Executive Officer Dr. Neal Walker and other members of Aclaris’ senior leadership team will participate in a fireside chat during the 2026 Jefferies Global Healthcare Conference in New York, NY.


A live and archived webcast of this event will be accessible on the[Events page](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=k8aHtaNjkRl8u5-0Q77vh1VbgWt5FDUXhMoTEG-oiOsSchqpVBljmy3D-1yjdKuzt-UvvQM-B-OlcychqKQLNzf5p9lgWlrEARGPLl7or08=) of the Aclaris website,[www.aclaristx.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=1dJRT65X6KNZj6vF6QG97nvF0lDP-4KY8rBLGQxbg-03tnfbnTdgRuXBB1uz8jcZf8Niw-RDcvxgcDPiIVlf039m71c7BkffwTDaoIF-6cA=) . The webcast will be available on the Aclaris website for at least 30 days.


**About Aclaris Therapeutics, Inc.**


Aclaris Therapeutics, Inc. is a clinical-stage biopharmaceutical company developing a pipeline of novel product candidates to address the needs of patients with immuno-inflammatory diseases who lack satisfactory treatment options. The company has a multi-stage portfolio of product candidates powered by a robust R&D engine. For additional information, please visit[www.aclaristx.com](http://www.aclaristx.com/) and follow Aclaris on[LinkedIn](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Qwxd6uK_Didk74gKSboI1KH3XE8fgfZgeSgvwS-DZoKKnxQmNH2cNSUi4PsdszKZojAUnI_p18vvzNbXqUcoaSsxEEtA-b8jZJ27pw9j6-eJE4mv5SM81K4iWb0nzx6N) .
